scope: PartConfiguration stores independent multi-track and individual-track view preferences. Nil requests use false on export, which materializes explicit false bytes. The consumer keeps a global boolean and an enabled-track set, null when none are enabled.
provenance: Original two-track GPIF has four distinct ordered measure occurrences: notes, whole rest, whole rest, notes. Each has unique bar, voice and beat definitions. The original pinned GP7 grand-staff source has nine measures per staff.
cleanup: Strict artifact export clears unrelated version provenance, track display bits, pan/volume automations, UseRse and authored empty short names. No notation, notes, measure ordering or style preferences are cleared.
checks: All 27 absent/false/true combinations pass exact raw consumer preferences, notation, note values and measure counts.
Explicit pointer values are independent; export does not mutate the source.
Missing views leave public preferences absent; export defaults them to false.
Invalid boolean byte 2 is rejected at each view through Parse and ParseWithOptions.
The former reader overlay fails the non-default public regression.
